extra.message: No HTTPS enforcement — cleartext transmission of all traffic

extra.message: API keys have no expiration — active keys persist indefinitely with no automatic expiry

class ApiKey(models.Model):
    STATES = [("active", "Active"), ("revoked", "Revoked"), ("expired", "Expired")]

metadata.proof: SOURCE: The ApiKey model defines an 'expired' status in STATES but has no expires_at DateTimeField and no background job or cron to automatically transition active keys to expired. There is also no cascade revocation when the owning user's account is disabled or their password is rotated (if password rotation were implemented). Perpetual keys increase the blast radius of any key leak.
